title: Rogue Trooper #1 Quality Comics October 1986 First Issue ABC Warriors 2000 AD
condition_description: Covers bright with light wear; a small purple dot by the top '75c' and light edge wear along the lower left of the front. Spine and staples intact. See photos.
description:
Rogue Trooper #1 (October 1986), Quality Comics - the first issue of the US reprint series of the 2000 AD strip created by Gerry Finley-Day and Dave Gibbons. Also features The A.B.C. Warriors (Hammer-Stein, Deadlock, Joe Pineapple, Happy Shrapnel, Mongrol and Blackblood).

Back cover: Codename Talon: Steel Claw #1 house ad.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
